# Quanta — Language Core Roadmap

## The Quanta programming language itself.

**Single source of truth for Quanta's own implementation.** All status derived from `docs/status.json` (generated by `scripts/verify_status.quanta`). Domain capabilities live in `docs/roadmap/domains/*.md`.

---

## Self-Improvement Prerequisites (from `status.json`)

Quanta can only self-improve when its core subsystems are in place. These are the **hard prerequisites** before the self-improvement loop (read roadmap → generate code → test → merge) can run:

| SI Component | Prerequisite | Quanta Module | Status (from status.json) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spec Parser | stdlib I/O + markdown parser | `std/io` + `std/regex` | ✅ verified |
| Spec-to-IR mapper | IR + type system stable | `std/ir` + `std/types` | ✅ verified |
| Code synthesizer | Pattern library + codegen | `std/patterns` + `std/codegen` | ✅ verified |
| Quanta emitter | Compiler + AST + printer | `compiler` + `std/ast` + `std/fmt_ir` | ✅ verified |
| Test generator | Test harness + EXPECTED.tsv | `std/testing` + `test/` | ✅ verified |
| Merge automation | Git integration + CI | `std/git` + `std/ci` | ✅ verified |

**All 6 core prerequisites ✅ verified** — the 11 stdlib modules exist and are non-trivial.

## 0.0.169: String Parameter Bug Fix ✅ DONE

Fixed critical bug where string literals lost `vreg_is_str` tag when passed as function parameters, blocking Quanta-native SI pipeline.

**Changes:**
- `emitter.quanta`: Added `find_str_source()` helper to follow `IR_MOV` chains to original `IR_STR` source
- `method.quanta`: Call-site string tag recording uses `find_str_source()` to propagate tags through `IR_MOV`
- `entry.quanta`: `IR_PARAM` reads `fn_parstr` to tag param vregs; two-phase compile (parse all → fixup → codegen all)
- `globals.quanta`: Added `fn_parstr` array (200 params × 250000 fns max) for per-param string tags

**Verified:** `file_open(path, 0)` with `path` as function parameter now returns `fd=3` (was `-2`). All 11 gates GREEN. Fixpoint verified.

## Verification Gate (CI Gate 12)

```
scripts/verify_status.quanta → docs/status.json → docs/status.md
```

**Fails if:**
- Any roadmap doc claims ✅ but `status.json` says stub/partial/missing
- Any `status.json` verified module fails compile/const-test
- Flint/Soup libraries needed but not in roadmap AND not implemented

Run after all 11 existing gates. Must pass for merge.
